name: A revertible parent owns every irreversible subjob effect

payload.shape: a composite operation marks child work revertible while child preparation already migrates, deletes, or publishes durable owner state
algorithm: enumerate side effects performed before that mark
tag each effect with transaction owner and compensator
place a deterministic failure in a later sibling
compare restored parent metadata with every side-effect owner
reconstruct the highest consumer from a cold process or cache
lift identity reuse into a successful destructive consumer
validate a pre-apply guard or delayed-publication counterfactual
negative_screens: all child effects share the parent transaction
every early side effect has an exact rollback compensator
later sibling failure occurs before destructive preparation
cold and warm consumers reconstruct the same durable owner set

title: Failed multi-schema AUTO_RANDOM conversion can make a cold TiDB overwrite existing rows

payload.p_check: all multi-schema subjobs are at a revertible point and parent saves TableInfo
payload.q_claim: a later sibling failure can restore the complete pre-DDL schema and allocator identity
payload.failure: modify-column preparation has already set AutoRandomBits, rebased AutoRandom, and deleted RowID before the parent non-revertible boundary
payload.c3_oracle: cold INSERT collides at id 1; generated REPLACE succeeds with affected_rows 2 and removes the durable id 2 preimage

dedup.result: no exact upstream issue or internal root; id2970003 is a successful AUTO_ID_CACHE=1 migration owner-selection bug, not failed composite rollback

provenance.source: TiDB 05b396fb6636 and nightly ed2376acc6; default cache; MDL ON

name: Multi-schema DDL and allocator side-effect owners

payload.parent_owner: onMultiSchemaChange saves TableInfo and subjob state before final transition
payload.child_owner: onModifyColumn calls checkAndApplyAutoRandomBits before doModifyColumnNoCheck marks the proxy non-revertible
payload.rollback_owner: restore saved TableInfo and subjob states
payload.cold_consumer: NewAllocatorsFromTblInfo after TiDB restart or scale-out
payload.highest_consumer: generated REPLACE interprets a reused primary key as an existing row to delete

name: Failed composite DDL restores schema and allocator identity together

payload.p_check: parent DDL and all subjobs finish rollback
payload.q_claim: post-error schema and generated identity allocation equal the pre-DDL state
payload.missing_owner: allocator migration commits outside the restored TableInfo snapshot
payload.red: post-error schema combines AUTO_INCREMENT and AUTO_RANDOM; cold RowID starts at 1 and reuses durable handles
payload.green: reject migration before apply; pure AUTO_INCREMENT schema and cold ID 30001 are preserved

provenance.source: current-master RED and exact guard GREEN

name: Failed DDL preserves schema flags, allocator owners, and row preimages

SHOW TABLE NEXT_ROW_ID for every allocator type

name: Failed composite AUTO_RANDOM migration followed by TiDB restart or scale-out

payload.production_story: A migration converts a populated clustered AUTO_INCREMENT key to AUTO_RANDOM while adding a business unique index. Existing duplicate business values make the ALTER return 1062. Automation treats rollback done as unchanged. A rolling restart, scale-out, or failover routes generated writes to a cold TiDB.
requires: composite conversion plus a later deterministic subjob failure
payload.highest_consumer: REPLACE or equivalent duplicate-key upsert removes an existing row

provenance.source: current-master and nightly two-TiDB real-TiKV execution

environment.topology: warm and brand-new cold TiDB, one PD, one real TiKV

evidence.post_schema: AUTO_INCREMENT plus AUTO_RANDOM; cold RowID next 1 and AutoRandom next 30002
evidence.fresh_preimage: id 2 original-14 absent and cold-replace visible

environment.topology: warm and brand-new cold TiDB, one PD, one real TiKV

evidence.causal_dimension: both destructive migration and later sibling failure are required

code_ref.counterfactual: reject AUTO_RANDOM conversion in multi-schema before checkAndApplyAutoRandomBits

environment.topology: warm and brand-new cold patched TiDB, one PD, one real TiKV
